BiblicalUsage: Breath is in God's hand, and Belshazzar learns it too late. Daniel tells him the God in whose hand his breath is, and whose are all his ways, he has not glorified — the king who praised gods of silver and gold while the breath in his own lungs belonged to another.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe every breath I take is held by God: Belshazzar's was, and mine is, and the question is whether I glorify the hand that holds it.
